scope: Proposed roadmap from completed startup diagnostics through dual-arm cutting and later learning. Counts are not time estimates.

Run isolated blade/coupon initial and stationary checks.

Define contact coordinates, signs, weights and margin rules.
Build and check the contact snapshot adapter.

Generate and verify particle/edge/face contacts on an analytic box.
Check translated/rotated contact-record coordinates on that box.

Corrected-frame coupled knife-force/moment, independent body-work reconstruction, preload time-step accuracy and preload energy gates now pass. Actual moving-blade work remains open.

items.title: Run a slow, short cut with force, penetration and work logging.
items.progress: Prefracture integration: actual fixed-mount robot contact passes with a small elastic coupon. Short tomato cuts await the remaining material, support and coupled-work gates.

items.title: Verify meaningful separation without unstable or spurious forces.
items.progress: Verify complete mechanical disconnection, withdraw the blade and observe at least one second of independent motion with stable reclosure/board contact.

items.title: Check repeatability and sensitivity to time step/contact resolution.
items.progress: Check fresh/reset repeatability; refine time step, quadrature, solver and mesh separately. Report force, work, release and end-cap profile sensitivity.

items.title: Save a reproducible baseline scene, settings and results.
items.progress: Freeze the reproducible single-arm scene, controller, evaluator and traces; close the loaded post-cut reset gate.

items.title: Integrate the second arm and its grasp/support role.
items.progress: Keep the right fixed mount; qualify contact-based left-hand support under measured cutting loads and remove hidden fixture support.

items.title: Verify coordinated motion, mutual collisions and force transfer.
items.progress: Verify support handoff, synchronized force transfer, knife–hand clearance, disturbances and prechecked failure responses.

items.title: Repeat the controlled cutting baseline with both arms.
items.progress: Repeat paired fixture-versus-left-support cuts with unchanged right controller, quality/load/slip metrics and reproducible reset.

items.title: Finalize observations, actions, rewards and termination conditions.
items.progress: Bind the existing offline contracts to the qualified environment. Start with bounded draw/down residuals and verified observations; keep orientation locked.

items.title: Validate repeated resets and scripted baseline episodes.
items.progress: Verify success/failure/abort resets, no history leakage, frozen train/development/test cases and measured rollout cost.

items.title: Run a small training/evaluation pilot before longer experiments.
items.progress: Run a budgeted baseline-versus-residual pilot, multiple seeds and paired held-out cases; use uncertainty and compute cost to decide further experiments.

integration_checkpoints.title: Benchmark & shape evaluator
integration_checkpoints.detail: Curved cap: centre 10 mm, surrounding samples 7.78 mm. Reference and shape controls pass.

integration_checkpoints.title: Slow scripted dry motion
integration_checkpoints.detail: Original16-second cycle preserved. Corrected controller passes independent readback: peak simulated tool error0.029mm, settled0.006mm; rigid mount, target gap32.4mm and board height12.0mm. Actual cutting approach still needs its own dry check.

integration_checkpoints.title: Near-target dry approach
integration_checkpoints.detail: New16-second approach/withdraw/return passes independent measured-state/geometry checks. Stopped19.98mm above conservative tomato envelope, peak tracking error0.066mm. No target dynamics/contact or cutting.

integration_checkpoints.title: Live robot + target clear hold
integration_checkpoints.detail: 0.1s:24robot/240target steps, matching clocks; independent node/display/geometry readback passes. Stable supported equilibrium,24.15mm blade gap, original fixture/free cap. No populated contact forces or cutting.

integration_checkpoints.title: Mounted robot contact

integration_checkpoints.title: Full-surface contact operators
integration_checkpoints.detail: Complete collision surface and independent force mapping verified.

integration_checkpoints.title: Cutting-edge geometry
integration_checkpoints.detail: Current overlap, inward sweep, broad-face negative control, withdrawal and reset pass. No mechanical cut.

integration_checkpoints.title: Pressure force & moment
integration_checkpoints.detail: Physical reaction and full-registry planar controls pass. Host actual-CAD geometry, positive material quadrature and force/energy derivatives pass. Six native actual-CAD force/energy/wrench/matrix controls pass. Actual robot work remains open.

integration_checkpoints.title: Coupled solver: component checks
integration_checkpoints.detail: Independent matrix, energy and loaded-force references pass; analytic freefall and basic reset pass. Static-search controls and the separately checked gravity-preload state pass. Full cutting remains unqualified.

integration_checkpoints.title: 100 ms dynamics & replay
integration_checkpoints.detail: Two full-target episodes pass force/energy, volume and board impact. Strict replay velocity difference: 1.4e−12 m/s.

integration_checkpoints.title: Short time-step screen
integration_checkpoints.detail: Three identical-source settings: finest-pair difference 0.77 µm and 0.925 mm/s per component. 10 ms scope only.

integration_checkpoints.title: Contact-preload time-step check
integration_checkpoints.detail: Protected equivalent-frame factors 64/128 pass at all 512 common clocks per case: 0.018 µm position and 0.650 mm/s velocity differences. Force and impulse pass. Only the assigned 0.833 ms preload; earlier failed studies remain evidence.

integration_checkpoints.title: Synchronized unloaded support
integration_checkpoints.detail: Two ten-second episodes pass with matching robot/target clocks, original fixture/free cap and exact replay. Board penetration: 4.9 µm.

integration_checkpoints.title: Small forces and twists
integration_checkpoints.detail: PASS within scope — two down and two lateral/twist synthetic 0.01 N pulses with observation, work and replay. This is not the full cutting-load envelope.

integration_checkpoints.title: Signed robot-load calibration
integration_checkpoints.detail: All 17 signed force/moment, actual-CAD off-centre, replay and clear cases pass original reaction precision limits. Equivalent COM joint-reporting frame; exact unchanged masses/inertias; 136 robot-only steps.

integration_checkpoints.title: Stationary mounted-knife feedback
integration_checkpoints.detail: 4,096 actual coupled intervals independently checked. Knife force error 0.57 µN; moment error 0.0032 µNm, both below unchanged limits. Full robot body-work channels reconstruct. Actual moving-blade work remains separate.

integration_checkpoints.title: Contact-preload work
integration_checkpoints.detail: Protected fine run and independent raw pressure/body-work readback pass. Whole contact-energy error including absolute remap jumps: 0.77%, below the registered 1% limit. Clear and loaded replay pass. Actual tool poses do not move at this tiny preload scale.
